note: What people must sign off before the exhibit opens, outside the staff review app, and whether they have. An entry counts as signed only with who signed it, the date, and a reference to the signed record (a scan or sheet in data/curation-decisions/, or the decision's own reference). Only the person signing, or someone recording their signature, fills an entry in; npm run readiness only reads this file.
